WITH sma_10004_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , store_id AS store
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __cancelled_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __partial_refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __full_refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END AS __gross_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __discount_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __refund_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id ELSE NULL END AS __selling_store_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_22.store, subq_28.store) AS store
  , MAX(subq_22.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_22.payment_cents) AS payment_cents
  , MAX(subq_22.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  , MAX(subq_22.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_22.gross_cents) AS gross_cents
  , MAX(subq_22.discount_cents) AS discount_cents
  , MAX(subq_22.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_22.refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_22.selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  , MAX(subq_22.valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_order_value
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_buyer_value
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.valid_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS purchase_frequency
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.refund_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.payment_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_amount_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.cancelled_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS cancel_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.refund_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_order_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.discount_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.gross_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS discount_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_28.valid_order_items AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_28.valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    store
    , SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(__partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
    , SUM(__full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
    , SUM(__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
    , SUM(__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    store
) subq_22
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    store
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    store
) subq_28
ON
  subq_22.store = subq_28.store
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_22.store, subq_28.store)
